title: MemoryProposal
description: An explicit proposed memory operation — the object agents (and workers, via proposed_learnings) actually emit. Applying a proposal produces a MemoryRevision. Auto-apply policy: create/revise/archive of the agent's own memory within quota; review required for delete, shared memory, or memory referenced by another agent.

agent_id.description: Owner of the memory being changed.

target_memory_ids.description: Empty for create; one id for revise/supersede/archive/delete; multiple parents for merge.
